# Mark

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Mark`](gmeow-Mark.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Mark>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

A brand / sign / name / logo that can be trademarked — the thing a [`gmeow:Trademark`](gmeow-Trademark.md) protects ([schema:Brand](https://schema.org/Brand)). An information object: it may itself bear a [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](gmeow-RightsStatement.md) (logos are also copyright works).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Mark`](gmeow-Mark.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
